business_summary: Manufacturer of custom-fit floor liners and cargo mats made in the USA. Products are sold in sets ranging from $150 to $250, targeting consumers who have recently purchased a new vehicle.
product: Custom-fit floor liners and cargo mats
stated_claims: Custom-fit floor liners and cargo mats

relevant_tags.why: The product is custom-fit to specific vehicles, appealing to consumers seeking personalized/tailored physical goods.
Adjacent category; new homeowners often undergo major life milestones like buying a new vehicle.

note_signals.why: Suburban buyers have high car-ownership rates and are highly likely to purchase protective vehicle accessories.
New-home life events strongly correlate with other major life purchases like a new vehicle.
Family households are prime buyers of larger new vehicles (SUVs, minivans) and highly value protective floor mats for spills.

gate_reason: The product, price point, and target audience (new vehicle buyers) are clearly defined, allowing for immediate strategic placement.
missing_info: Return policy details for custom-fit items
clarifying_questions: Do you support all major vehicle makes and models, or is your catalog restricted to specific brands?
